arming_sequence.name: DARK deployment
arming_sequence.purpose: Deploy merged code + apply migrations with ALL flags OFF
arming_sequence.stop_condition: Any migration failure, any CI red, any golden STOP-check drift
arming_sequence.rollback: Redeploy prior image tag; migrations for the three broker-connectivity apps are additive and safe to leave applied while flags are OFF

arming_sequence.name: Provisioner + validation image ready
arming_sequence.purpose: Re-stage agent bundle (fail-closed protocol), stage governed build-5833 validation image, keep 6073 as rollback
arming_sequence.stop_condition: assert_compatible fails; verify_image fails; source-hash drift; isolation check fails
arming_sequence.rollback: Revert active validation terminal to the 6073 baseline (directory/config swap; probe is side-effect-free)

arming_sequence.name: Operator observability arming
arming_sequence.purpose: Enable OPERATIONS_EVENTS_ENABLED (backend) then rebuild+deploy frontend with NEXT_PUBLIC_OPERATIONS_ENABLED
arming_sequence.stop_condition: Recorder-failure log spike (guvfx.operational_events); API 5xx; owner-scoping check fails
arming_sequence.rollback: Set OPERATIONS_EVENTS_ENABLED OFF (immediate); redeploy DARK frontend image. Truncate/rebuild the projection if needed (rebuildable cache)

arming_sequence.name: Customer journey arming
arming_sequence.purpose: Enable BROKER_CONNECTIVITY_ENABLED (backend, needs signing keyring) then rebuild+deploy frontend with NEXT_PUBLIC_BROKER_CONNECTIVITY_ENABLED
arming_sequence.stop_condition: Validation UNAVAILABLE storm; isolation_check_failed / impl_integrity_mismatch; any credential-handling anomaly
arming_sequence.rollback: Set BROKER_CONNECTIVITY_ENABLED OFF (surface returns 404 immediately); redeploy DARK frontend
arming_sequence.constraint: May be armed for account onboarding/validation BEFORE health/execution arming — validation and onboarding do not place orders. Execution stays disabled until stage 6.

arming_sequence.name: Health arming
arming_sequence.purpose: Enable BROKER_CONNECTIVITY_HEALTH_ENABLED so health converges on customer validation evidence
arming_sequence.stop_condition: Health state not converging; unexpected DEGRADED/DISCONNECTED distribution; scheduler unexpectedly active
arming_sequence.rollback: Set BROKER_CONNECTIVITY_HEALTH_ENABLED OFF; engine returns to DARK instantly. No auto-resume exists
arming_sequence.constraint: Health emits signals only; it never pauses/resumes/executes. Pause/dispatch enforcement needs stage 6 too.

arming_sequence.name: Execution enforcement arming
arming_sequence.purpose: Enable BROKER_CONNECTIVITY_EXECUTION_GATE (creation + claim + final-dispatch gates; pause/resume active with health)
arming_sequence.stop_condition: Execution-refusal spike for eligible accounts; any execution permitted for an ineligible account; rollback cannot restore safe state
arming_sequence.rollback: Set BROKER_CONNECTIVITY_EXECUTION_GATE (and HEALTH if needed) OFF; gate becomes transparent instantly

arming_sequence.name: Trusted-Beta invitation
arming_sequence.purpose: Invite the explicit, capacity-limited Trusted-Beta cohort
arming_sequence.stop_condition: Any SEV-1; cohort/capacity limit reached; support/incident capacity exceeded
arming_sequence.rollback: Pause invitations; if needed disarm execution (stage 6 rollback). Existing users are unaffected by pausing new invitations
arming_sequence.constraint: ONLY after WP6 PASS and explicit Sponsor arming approval.

partial_arming_states.safest_action: None required; this is the safe resting state

partial_arming_states.safest_action: Redeploy DARK frontend OR enable the backend flag to match — do not leave mismatched
partial_arming_states.flag_rollback: Redeploy frontend built with the flag unset

partial_arming_states.state: BROKER_CONNECTIVITY_ENABLED ON but frontend flag OFF
partial_arming_states.customer_impact: None (no UI entry); API reachable only to authenticated direct callers
partial_arming_states.safest_action: Acceptable transient during staged arming; complete stage 4 or disarm

Operator sees empty/404 data; enable backend flag or redeploy DARK frontend

partial_arming_states.trading_impact: None — health emits signals only; no pause/resume/dispatch enforcement without the gate
partial_arming_states.safest_action: Acceptable observation state; health converges but does not enforce

partial_arming_states.trading_impact: Execution refused unless VALIDATED+eligible; existing eligible flows unchanged
partial_arming_states.safest_action: Monitor refusal rate; if eligible accounts are wrongly refused, disarm the gate
partial_arming_states.flag_rollback: Set BROKER_CONNECTIVITY_EXECUTION_GATE OFF (gate becomes transparent instantly)

partial_arming_states.state: Frontend and backend images at different build versions
partial_arming_states.safest_action: Redeploy to a single consistent version pair; treat as a deploy defect
partial_arming_states.flag_rollback: Redeploy the matched DARK image pair

partial_arming_states.state: Agent bundle does not advertise the full PROVISIONING_OPERATIONS set
partial_arming_states.safest_action: Re-stage the correct agent bundle before/with the backend (ADR-0014 ordering)

partial_arming_states.customer_impact: Validation returns UNAVAILABLE (retryable) — customer not asked to re-enter correct credentials
partial_arming_states.safest_action: Restore the agent (host); validation is fail-closed UNAVAILABLE meanwhile

partial_arming_states.state: build-5833 validation image fails verify_image / dirty baseline
partial_arming_states.safest_action: Rebuild the isolated image or revert to the 6073 rollback baseline

partial_arming_states.state: A broker-connectivity migration fails to apply
partial_arming_states.safest_action: Halt arming; redeploy prior image; the three apps' migrations are additive — resolve before proceeding
partial_arming_states.flag_rollback: N/A — keep flags OFF; do not arm on a failed migration

partial_arming_states.state: operational-event API/recorder failing while OPERATIONS_EVENTS_ENABLED ON
partial_arming_states.safest_action: Set OPERATIONS_EVENTS_ENABLED OFF; investigate guvfx.operational_events logs; authoritative state is unaffected

partial_arming_states.trading_impact: Only if the gate is also ON
partial_arming_states.safest_action: Disarm the gate first (stop enforcement), then the health flag; investigate with per-account get_contract
partial_arming_states.flag_rollback: Set BROKER_CONNECTIVITY_EXECUTION_GATE OFF then BROKER_CONNECTIVITY_HEALTH_ENABLED OFF

partial_arming_states.state: Elevated EXECUTION_GATE_REFUSED / EXECUTION_DISPATCH_REFUSED for eligible accounts
partial_arming_states.safest_action: Disarm the execution gate immediately (transparent when OFF); investigate eligibility/health inputs
